passives.name: Nirvana's Inferno
passives.description: (Triggered Effect) When an ally is hit, counterattacks with Nirvana's Inferno. Before attacking, removes [Buff_V_2000080_2_2_1] buff(s) from the target, and reduces Evasion for [Buff_T_2000080_2_4_1] turn(s). If the target is Earth element, ignores their Resilience, and does not miss.

buffs.summary: −100% BUFF_RESIST if attacker has element advantage
−100% BUFF_RESIST if attacker has element disadvantage
−100% BUFF_RESIST if attacker has no element advantage/disadvantage
